evals.expected_output: Should find auth-design.md as the top result, possibly also api-reference.md. Should present the results clearly with paths and titles.
expectations: Output mentions auth-design.md as a search result
The agent ran docnav search command via the wrapper script
Results are presented in a readable format, not raw tab-separated output

evals.expected_output: Should show outgoing links (user-store.md, api-reference.md), backlinks (user-store.md, api-reference.md), and related docs. Should present a coherent navigation view.
expectations: Output shows outgoing links from auth-design.md (user-store.md and api-reference.md)
The agent ran at least two docnav commands (links and backlinks)
Results distinguish between outgoing links and incoming backlinks
